status: Recommendation for a playable experiment; not adopted runtime rules or a validated balance.

target.end_condition: Death only; no automatic time cutoff.
target.note: Design target informed by genre benchmarks, not an observed average in this game.

keep: Three distinct random eligible choices per level, with gameplay paused.
Six hardware slots; three separate incremental picks per module.
16 module blueprints, seven research families and six earned evolution recipes.
First two completed evolution recipes activate.
Four uncapped research families preserve at least three eligible choices.
Rarity weights 60/35/5 for new blueprints and research quality; draw weights renormalize when a bucket is empty.
display_rules: An owned module keeps its original rarity label but its next rank uses the Common draw bucket. This does not grant a guaranteed owned card.
Permanent uncapped research gains use 1 + floor((upgrade choice ordinal - 1) / 15): picks 1–15 give 1×, 16–30 give 2×, 31–45 give 3×. Old gains do not multiply.

Apply research bundles only to Weapon Damage, Hull Reinforcement, Shield Capacity and Specimen Value. Keep fire rate, capture speed and immediate repairs unchanged. Show actual values before selection.
Rerolls refresh all three options and preserve all eligibility rules. Two per run, with no automatic refill.
unresolved_before_balance_signoff: Retune post-10-minute encounter pressure and sustain so mixed builds meet the 20–30-minute good-run target. No tested profile yet meets that target robustly.
Give capture specialists a clear score or resource payoff for their survival tradeoff; model vehicle capture score is an arbitrary flat five.
Spread late difficulty escalation across encounters; deaths cluster around scheduled boss windows.
Check whether easier owned ranks and rerolls make the same six-module roster too repeatable.
Measure actual lateral movement, capture retention, attack telegraphs and dodging before trusting simulated survival.
